title: A Vector for the Static
author: Paloma Okonkwo
blurb: Noor Fairweather, a xenolinguist who can no longer dream in human languages, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. But when an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
